previewText: Find the Drafty Door Before the First Cool Night, Norcross Art Splash this weekend, and a quick Gwinnett and Walton market check.

dannysNote.author: automated
paragraphs: September is wrapping up, and October is right around the corner. This week's homeowner tip is a quick draft check around your doors and windows before the cooler nights settle in.
If you are looking for something to do this weekend, Norcross Art Splash fills Thrasher Park on Saturday and Sunday, and admission is free. If anything here sparks a question, just hit reply.

market.title: Gwinnett and Walton County: August 2026 at a glance
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: In August 2026, Realtor.com counted 3,828 active listings in Gwinnett County, 11.4% more than a year earlier. The median listing price was $450,000, and homes spent a median of 54 days on the market.
Walton County had 638 active listings in August 2026, 11.0% more than a year earlier, with a median listing price of $490,000 and a median of 65 days on the market.
The simple version for Gwinnett and Walton County: buyers have more homes to compare than they did a year ago, so pricing and condition matter more than ever.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data, August 2026 (latest monthly release, downloaded September 28, 2026). Figures are countywide listing data, not closed sales.

rotatingFeatures.label: HOMEOWNER / SEASONAL HOME TIP
rotatingFeatures.title: Find the Drafty Door Before the First Cool Night
rotatingFeatures.topic: a quick draft check around your doors and windows
paragraphs: On a breezy afternoon, walk around the inside of your exterior doors and windows and feel for moving air. Worn weatherstripping and small gaps in caulk are easy to miss in summer and easy to notice once the nights cool off.
items: Look for daylight under or around exterior doors.
Check weatherstripping for cracks, flattening, or pieces that have pulled loose.
Note gaps in the caulk where window trim meets the wall.
rotatingFeatures.closing: ENERGY STAR lists weatherstripping doors and caulking windows among the simpler projects that can help a home feel more comfortable. Bigger jobs, like attic air sealing, are worth a pro's opinion.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: ENERGY STAR, Seal and Insulate with ENERGY STAR.

rotatingFeatures.label: LOCAL COMMUNITY EVENT
rotatingFeatures.title: Norcross Art Splash
rotatingFeatures.availability: Saturday, October 3, 10 AM-6 PM, and Sunday, October 4, 10 AM-5 PM; free admission
paragraphs: Downtown Norcross fills Thrasher Park with about one hundred artists from across the country, showing folk art, ceramics, paintings, photography, fiber art, metalwork, and jewelry.
There is also a Kidz Zone with face painting and sand art, plus festival food. Leashed pets are welcome, and admission is free.
rotatingFeatures.closing: Thrasher Park, 93 Park Drive, Norcross. Several downtown lots offer parking, with accessible parking on Wingo Street.
rotatingFeatures.source: Source: Splash Festivals, Norcross Art Splash visitor information.
